cookie-tray-flatlay.title: Christmas cookie tray with icing on a wooden table, top view
cookie-tray-flatlay.buyer: Bakeries and food bloggers running Christmas promotions
cookie-tray-flatlay.prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph, horizontal 4:3, warm window light, shallow depth of field. Top-down flatlay of a tray of iced Christmas cookies on a wooden table. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names or watermark. Substantial clean copy space on the right.
